name: Gamuda Berhad
overview: 2026年，Gamuda 就北霹雳水处理及输水基础设施项目与槟城售水安排签署的谅解备忘录两度延期，Bulk Water Supply Agreement 的签署期限最终延至2026年7月13日。公司同时完成两次单层中期股息派发，并以股息再投资计划发行新股。
overview_en: In 2026, Gamuda extended its Memorandum of Understanding for the proposed water treatment and distribution infrastructure in Northern Perak and the sale of treated water to Penang twice, with the deadline for executing the Bulk Water Supply Agreement ultimately extended to 13 July 2026. The company also completed two single-tier interim dividend payouts and issued new shares under its dividend reinvestment plan.

segments.name: 工程与建设
segments.note: 今年就北霹雳水处理及输水基础设施项目签署的谅解备忘录两度延期，Bulk Water Supply Agreement 签署期限延至2026年7月13日。
segments.note_en: This year, the Memorandum of Understanding for the proposed water treatment and distribution infrastructure in Northern Perak was extended twice, with the deadline for executing the Bulk Water Supply…

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 就北霹雳水处理及输水基础设施开发及向槟城出售处理水项目，将Bulk Water Supply Agreement的签署期限延长至2026年7月13日。
actions.text_en: Extended the deadline for execution of the Bulk Water Supply Agreement for the proposed development of water treatment and distribution infrastructure in Northern Perak and the sale of treated water to Penang to 13 July 2026.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年完成两次单层中期股息派发，并以股息再投资计划发行新股。
segments.note_en: This year, the company completed two single-tier interim dividend payouts and issued new shares under its dividend reinvestment plan.

actions.title: GAMUDA - Notice of Book Closure
actions.text: 派发2026财年第二次单层中期股息每股RM0.05，并以股息再投资计划发行新股，发行价定为RM3.76。
actions.text_en: Declared the second single-tier interim dividend for FYE 2026 of RM0.05 per share and issued new shares under the dividend reinvestment plan at an issue price of RM3.76.

actions.title: GAMUDA - Notice of Book Closure
actions.text: 派发2026财年第一次单层中期股息每股RM0.05，并以股息再投资计划发行新股，发行价定为RM4.15。
actions.text_en: Declared the first single-tier interim dividend for FYE 2026 of RM0.05 per share and issued new shares under the dividend reinvestment plan at an issue price of RM4.15.
